newsitem.title: FRANCE: Usinor shares jump despite profit fall.
newsitem.headline: Usinor shares jump despite profit fall.

text.p: Shares in steelmaker Usinor jumped on Tuesday after the group reported a fall in 1996 profit which was not as steep as some market operators had feared, brokers said.

Usinor said net attributable profit fell to 1.49 billion francs from 4.43 billion in 1995 and cut its dividend to three francs per share from four. "Most people were expecting it to be reduced by half," a trader said.
The stock was up 3.67 percent at 87.60 francs at 1015 GMT after drifting off an early, and year, high of 89.90 francs.

Usinor chairman Francis Mer said he hoped for better 1997 results based on signs of a pickup in demand but it said average prices would be lower this year. "That's the sting in the tail," a trader said.
